Additionally, Inter Globe's Price-to-Book ratio is exceptionally low at 0.46x [E2], suggesting that investors are not fully recognizing the company's asset value despite a book value of ₹138 per share. The sector median sales growth is forecasted at 16.3% [E50], implying Inter Globe could be undervalued given its compounded sales growth of -16% over the trailing twelve months [E14]. Despite these metrics, Inter Globe's screen reasons suggest strong profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year [E42] and earnings growth accelerating [E43], further supporting its potential as an undervalued investment opportunity.
